# `tfctl variable` reference

Manage workspace variables in HCP Terraform.

## Usage

```shell-session
$ tfctl variable <subcommand> [options]
```

## Description

The `tfctl variable` command provides subcommands for managing workspace variables. Use these commands to import variables from configuration files and manage variable values.

## Subcommands

- [`import`](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli/variable/import) - Import variables from a file

## Examples

The following command imports variables from a JSON file:

```shell-session
$ tfctl variable import --file variables.json
```

## Global flags

Refer to [Global flags reference](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli#global-flags) for information about flags you can use with all commands.
